a9375ad0bf0274b6.description: About DP World and the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Supervisor ITV to join its Operations team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. The ITV Supervisor is responsible for leading, controlling, and optimizing all Internal Terminal Vehicle (ITV) operations during assigned shifts, ensuring the safe, efficient, and continuous movement of containers between the quay, yard, and adjacent terminal areas. Role Overview The role involves managing ITV resources, monitoring fleet availability and utilization, maintaining operational performance, and ensuring compliance with operational procedures and HSSE requirements. The ITV Supervisor works closely with Vessel, Yard, and Planning teams to support operational continuity, minimize delays, and contribute to achieving vessel productivity and overall terminal performance targets. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coordinate all ITV activities during vessel loading and discharge operations, yard transfers, and Internal Terminal Transfers (ITT). Plan and allocate ITV drivers and equipment based on operational priorities and real-time demands. Monitor ITV cycle times, fleet utilization, equipment availability, and operational productivity, implementing corrective actions as needed. Coordinate closely with Vessel Supervisors, Yard Supervisors, Planning, and other operational teams to maintain workflow continuity. Ensure optimal utilization and balanced deployment of the ITV fleet to support operational efficiency and minimize idle time. Monitor driver attendance, deployment, performance, and discipline while addressing operational resource gaps. Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, delays, and inefficiencies impacting container movements and terminal performance. Coordinate with Engineering and maintenance teams to ensure timely resolution of equipment breakdowns and operational disruptions. Enforce compliance with HSSE policies, traffic management procedures, speed limits, designated routes, and PPE requirements. Conduct shift briefings and toolbox talks to communicate operational priorities, safety risks, and key operational updates. Monitor driving behavior and ensure adherence to safe operating practices and established procedures. Report and escalate accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions, and equipment-related incidents in accordance with company procedures. Evaluate driver performance and identify training and competency gaps, providing feedback for coaching and development. Prepare accurate shift reports covering fleet utilization, productivity, operational challenges, incidents, and equipment availability. Ensure effective shift handovers by communicating pending activities, operational constraints, and critical information to the incoming supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in container terminal operations. Proven experience in fleet supervision and resource coordination. Ability to contribute to safe and efficient terminal operations. Application Candidates with experience in container terminal operations, fleet supervision, and resource coordination who are ready to contribute to safe and efficient terminal operations are encouraged to apply.

a976be0838ea3a1f.description: About Tetra Pak and the Role Tetra Pak is dedicated to ensuring food safety and availability globally, while protecting food, people, and the planet. We are seeking a Warehouse Administrator to join our Supply Chain team in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah cities. This is a full-time, hybrid position that combines warehouse administration with production planning support, offering exposure to warehousing, logistics, inventory management, and production planning activities. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview and Focus This position primarily focuses on warehouse administration (70-80%) and provides backup support for production planning activities (20-30%). The Warehouse Administrator will collaborate with warehouse operations, supply chain teams, planning hubs, suppliers, and key stakeholders to ensure efficient material flow, accurate inventory, and operational excellence within the supply chain. The salary for this position is not disclosed. Key Responsibilities Manage inventory records and ensure stock accuracy across warehouse locations. Coordinate consumables management to support uninterrupted operations. Perform warehouse administration activities, including documentation, record keeping, and facilities coordination. Support purchasing activities and follow up with suppliers on orders and deliveries. Execute SAP transactions related to inventory movements, stock control, goods receipts, and warehouse operations. Monitor inventory discrepancies and support cycle counting and stock reconciliation processes. Maintain Daily Management System (DMS) boards, KPIs, and operational performance reports. Coordinate logistics-related activities and support effective communication between stakeholders. Participate in warehouse and supply chain meetings and support action tracking. Production Planning Support Provide backup support to production planning activities during planner absences or peak workload periods. Assist in the preparation and maintenance of weekly production plans. Support planning hub coordination and communication with internal stakeholders. Monitor production schedules and material availability to help ensure planned production requirements are achieved. Assist with planning-related reporting, data analysis, and schedule updates. Participate in supply chain coordination meetings to support production continuity and customer service objectives. Continuous Improvement and Safety Support World Class Manufacturing (WCM) initiatives and continuous improvement projects. Contribute to process optimization and operational efficiency improvements. Promote safety standards and support governance activities within warehouse and planning operations. Drive best practices related to inventory management, planning processes, and operational excellence. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Proactive and detail-oriented approach to tasks. Ability to collaborate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders. Proficiency in SAP transactions related to inventory and warehouse operations is beneficial.

a9ce80ec940ea522.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over one billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue through its diverse portfolio of beverages and convenient foods, including brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. The company's vision is to be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital to create value and growth. Role Overview PepsiCo is seeking a Sr. Storeman for a full-time position in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This role involves supervising overall warehouse functions to ensure compliance with contractual terms and maintaining equipment to support various departments including Production, Planning, Export, EHS, Quality and Food Safety, FGPM, and Freight. The Sr. Storeman acts as a coordination point between all departments and Distribution Centers (DCs). Key Responsibilities Coordinate with AGRO for daily potato consignment offloading plans. Circulate monthly IMPM reports to planning and finance for slow-moving material liquidation. Prepare weekly Ageing reports and follow up on online and quality rejected materials with relevant departments. Oversee quarterly calibration of weigh bridges and oil tanks. Upload Incident & Near Miss reports on MYEHS with effective action plans. Monitor daily internal transfer execution and weekly PO Status reports for utility coverage. Track supplier invoices and payments for services provided. Review all SAP movements through weekly test scripts and prepare monthly non-moving packaging material reports. Acknowledge and review daily documents processed by storekeepers. Ensure compliance with PIT procedures by FLT operators and follow up on FLT pre-maintenance. Review and submit monthly timesheets for contract laborers to HR. Implement SWP for all workflows and follow up on safety and forklift yearly training schedules. Ensure accurate and timely updates of daily and monthly reports, including KPI, Weekly Quality Hold, and Month End Closing. Optimize warehouse space utilization and ensure inbound and outbound flows adhere to procedures and company policies. Provide orientation for new SKUs to the warehouse crew and track daily KPIs for productivity targets. Inspect equipment usage, ensure checklist adherence, and align with the Engineering team for breakdowns. Prepare weekly plans and assign responsibilities/resources to meet production and sales requirements. Comply with all audit requirements, including COSO test effectiveness. Track Quality HOLD materials and communicate with the Quality team for process effectiveness. Monitor daily and monthly inventory, investigating root causes for any variances. Maintain Food Safety standards through document review and daily team alignment. Review SIT monthly and communicate with relevant plants. Conduct pre-shift meetings to allocate daily tasks and provide updates. Execute management-delivered tasks within specified timeframes. Comply with AIB standards through daily warehouse cleaning and documentation review. Participate in allocated projects for warehouse development, focusing on safety and hygiene. Execute and follow up on all write-offs for disposal. Monitor daily pending tasks for offloading. Coordinate with the Engineering Team for equipment services and yearly PM maintenance. Follow up on Mock Recall timeline tracking from receiving to issuance to production to ensure effectiveness. Qualifications and Experience Experience: Minimum of 2-5 years in a supply chain role, with cross-functional experience, preferably in warehouse operations. Experience in a food manufacturing organization is an advantage. Education: Degree in Commerce, Finance, or Technical studies. Certifications: Qualification in supply chain or warehousing management. Required Skills Ability to understand and align with business vision. Quick adaptability to new technologies and commitment to improving technical skills. Self-motivated with leadership qualities to identify, initiate, and implement corrective actions. Highly effective communication and negotiation skills. Strong analytical skills. Broad planning and cross-functional understanding. Proficiency in spoken and written English. Ability to work with motivation, enthusiasm, and under supervision. Reporting Structure and Decision-Making The Sr. Storeman reports directly to the Warehouse Manager. Peers include supervisors from AGRO, Production, Planning, EHS, Quality & Food Safety, and Engineering. Subordinates include Store Keepers and Dispatchers. This role holds decision-making authority for weekend schedules and work priorities.

a9e67740203a8013.job_title: School MIS Administrator Technical Experienced in Education field
a9e67740203a8013.description: About Ultra Point Establishment Ultra Point Establishment is an HR firm specializing in connecting talent with organizations to foster long-term success. The company provides expert recruitment, tailored consulting, and strategic workforce solutions for growing businesses. Ultra Point partners with clients to optimize human resources operations and support business goals through practical insights and strategies. Role Summary We are seeking a Management Information Systems (MIS) Officer to join an administrative team in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role requires a highly organized and detail-oriented individual with a strong technical background. The MIS Officer will be responsible for managing student information systems, maintaining accurate records, and providing administrative and technical support to ensure efficient school operations. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage and operate educational and administrative systems, including Noor, Engage, LMS, MIS, SIS, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Canva. Coordinate student admissions and registration processes, including online enrollment and application management. Maintain accurate physical and electronic student records, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and confidentiality. Manage official school documentation such as student contracts, enrollment files, transcripts, certificates, and graduation records. Update student personal and academic information across all approved school systems. Monitor and record student attendance, absences, and tardiness via the Noor System, and communicate updates as required. Prepare student reports, class lists, examination seating plans, attendance reports, and statistical reports. Organize documentation for school clubs, extracurricular activities, accreditation, and educational platforms. Coordinate school trips by preparing required documentation and securing all necessary approvals. Communicate with parents regarding registration, required documents, record updates, medical forms, and other official requirements. Maintain shared digital filing systems and ensure proper document management across departments. Support educational platforms through data migration, system maintenance, data verification, and quality assurance. Prepare graduation documentation, including transcripts, graduation files, certificates, and multimedia materials. Assist in organizing school events, parent meetings, orientation programs, and other administrative projects. Support the administration of assessments such as MAP, ABT, ETEC, and IB, including scheduling, documentation, and technical coordination. Provide administrative and technical support to school staff, including user training, surveys, meeting documentation, and other operational duties. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of five (5) years of experience in a K–12 school environment. Strong knowledge of the Noor System and Student Information Systems (SIS). Excellent proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other educational platforms. Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical support skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet deadlines. Ability to work independently and collaboratively while maintaining a high level of confidentiality and professionalism. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in either Jeddah or Makkah. The role involves working within a school administrative team, providing essential support for educational and operational functions. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary information will be disclosed during the interview process.

a9cdffb252358938.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Lifting & Rigging Supervisor for a full-time position. This role is responsible for overseeing safe and efficient lifting and transfer operations, ensuring compliance with company policies, quality, safety, and environmental management systems, as well as international standards. Key Responsibilities Manage, maintain, and improve the company’s health, safety, and environmental performance. Prepare lifting plans in collaboration with the Lifting Engineer, based on load handling requirements and available equipment. Lead assigned foremen, crew members, and contractors to successfully complete project lifting and rigging requirements. Support foremen in team distribution and daily task assignment according to operational priorities. Assist Superintendents and the L&R Manager in planning and maximizing department resource utilization and performance. Collaborate with the Technical Services HSE team to mitigate potential hazards and ensure a safe working environment. Review and confirm that all safety and operational requirements are met before any lifting or transfer operation. Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and international standards such as ISO, BS EN, ASME, LEEA, LOLER, and other approved codes of practice (ACOP). Support and review lift and rigging plans/forms with Lifting and Rigging Engineers, including crane load calculations and sling/shackle arrangements. Provide lifting expertise and guidance to Lifting Engineers, Lifting Supervisors, and senior planning management. Qualifications and Education A Diploma in Mechanical, Civil, Construction, Marine Engineering, or an equivalent field is preferred. Certifications and Accreditations LEEA Certified Appointed Person in Lifting is preferred. Lifting certifications such as Rigger 1 or Lifting Supervisor are desirable. Required Skills and Abilities Ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams across various technologies and implement training programs. Resilience under stress and capability to manage competing priorities effectively. Excellent interpersonal skills and articulate communication. Physically active and capable of passing a full medical assessment. Demonstrated ability to listen to others' views and respond logically without resorting to authority. Computer proficiency combined with strong leadership skills. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time Supervisor position at International Maritime Industries.

Conduct regular inspections and maintenance checks on the company vehicle to ensure optimal working condition. Promptly report any maintenance issues and coordinate necessary repairs. a9555cbca678e8fa.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco is seeking a Mechatronics Engineer to join the Mechanical Services Shops. This full-time position involves contributing to a team responsible for the repair of rotating and static equipment, as well as the fabrication of components. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the reliability, maintainability, and safe operation of integrated mechanical, electrical, control, robotic, and automated systems within the operational facility. Role Contribution The Mechatronics Engineer will lead efforts in troubleshooting, preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment upgrades, and lifecycle management. This includes overseeing production machinery and supporting assets to maintain operational efficiency and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement maintenance strategies for various integrated equipment, including CNC machines, robots, furnaces, test stands, pumps, compressors, conveyors, positioning systems, drives, sensors, pneumatics, and hydraulics. Perform diagnostics and root cause analysis for mechanical, electrical, servo, PLC, motion-control, hydraulic, pneumatic, and communication faults using technical drawings, diagnostic software, measurements, and failure evidence. Establish asset criticality, define PM/PdM tasks, and specify requirements for lubrication, alignment, vibration analysis, thermography, calibration, spare parts, and condition monitoring. Optimize maintenance intervals based on performance data. Engineer and validate machine upgrades, safety circuits, drives, sensors, tooling interfaces, and automation changes, including OEM retrofits, through controlled design, testing, and change management processes. Maintain CMMS master data, maintenance plans, procedures, breakdown records, KPIs, obsolescence plans, contractor controls, technical files, and training programs for maintainers and operators. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Environment Saudi Aramco offers challenging professional, technical, and industrial opportunities. Employees engage in world-scale projects, supported by significant investment in capital and technology. The company addresses global technical, logistical, and environmental challenges, investing heavily in talent development through extensive workforce development programs. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details are not disclosed.

a95ac22e877d4202.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث فندق سرايا طابه الفندقية عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريق العمل في المدينة المنورة. يمثل هذا الدور نقطة الاتصال الأولى للزوار والعملاء، ويتطلب شخصًا يتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة بفعالية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ الموظف المعني بوجود المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بلباقة واحترافية. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة والقدرة على إدارة الوقت. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل شفهي وكتابي ممتازة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. التعامل مع أنظمة الاتصالات والمكاتب. المرونة والقدرة على التكيف مع بيئة العمل المتغيرة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في فندق سرايا طابه الفندقية بالمدينة المنورة. يتوقع من موظف الاستقبال أن يكون جزءًا أساسيًا من الفريق، وأن يساهم في توفير تجربة إيجابية للزوار والعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

a9640a75dc0f6129.description: About the Role Aljomaih Energy and Water Company is seeking an HCIS Security Manager to join their team in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Rabigh. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the implementation and compliance of all High Commission for Industrial Security (HCIS) requirements during the construction phase of projects. The HCIS Security Manager acts as the primary liaison with HCIS authorities, ensuring all documentation, communication, and execution align with HCIS Security and Safety Standards. Key Responsibilities Oversee the development and implementation of HCIS requirements within projects. Manage the preparation and submission of HCIS documents to the HCIS authority in coordination with the EPC Contractor. Ensure continuous compliance with HCIS Standards and Specifications. Serve as the focal point for all HCIS coordination and communication with HCIS authorities, including necessary site visits. Lead and document comprehensive HCIS security risk assessments (physical, cyber, personnel) across all project phases, and develop and oversee the implementation of mitigation plans. Oversee the preparation, review, submission, and approval processes for all HCIS-related documentation, such as Security Master Plans, Risk Assessments, Security System Designs, and Compliance Reports, in coordination with SPV, EPC, and O&M contractors. Conduct regular internal audits and inspections to verify ongoing compliance with HCIS standards, and facilitate external audits by HCIS or their representatives. Track and ensure closure of identified non-conformities. Ensure EPC and O&M contractors fully understand and comply with their HCIS obligations as defined in their contracts and project plans, and monitor their security performance. Provide regular reports to SPV management and HCIS authorities on the status of HCIS compliance, risks, incidents, and mitigation actions. Post-HCIS Control Phase Support Once HCIS activities are established, this role will support the HSE team and contribute to Quality procedures, learning, and inspections. Responsibilities include: Ensuring personnel onsite attend relevant HSE inductions and trainings. Maintaining updated HSE procedures for specific tasks. Performing routine and random HSE inspections to monitor procedure implementation and follow up on corrective actions. Promoting a proactive and positive intervention approach within the Project team and disseminating HSE rules, standards, procedures, and communications onsite. Ensuring compliance with relevant risk assessments and preparation of Job Safety Analyses. Advising on safe operative techniques and methodologies for planning and safety control. Monitoring the effective implementation of the Permit to Work system and ensuring timely reporting of HSE events. Assisting in accident investigations and analysis to identify trends and propose corrective measures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in HCIS compliance and security management. Demonstrated knowledge of HCIS Security and Safety Standards and their application in projects. Experience in coordinating with regulatory authorities and managing documentation submissions. Ability to lead risk assessments and develop mitigation plans. Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective liaison with various stakeholders. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with operational responsibilities extending to Rabigh. The role involves working closely with project teams, contractors, and HCIS authorities to ensure stringent security and safety compliance throughout the construction phase.

Lead and ensure the effective cascading of operational strategy into mid to short-term production plans. Oversee and manage the identification of required inventory and approve purchase requisitions for materials, services, and manpower. a9d2d4719c392c1d.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مطعم عائض للوجبات السريعة عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تسهيل وتخليص المعاملات الحكومية ومتابعة شؤون الموظفين بالتنسيق مع الجهات الخارجية، مما يضمن سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع وتأمين وتوفير البيانات والمعلومات اللازمة للوثائق والشروط المطلوبة لتخليص المعاملات الحكومية. تخليص المعاملات الحكومية بسرعة وفعالية، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. تحديث واستكمال جميع متطلبات النماذج والمستندات والإجراءات الحكومية بما يتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المعمول بها. تنفيذ التعليمات المتعلقة بسرية التعاملات والسجلات، والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ الوثائق وتبويبها وترتيبها وفقاً للممارسات المتبعة في الشركة. استقبال استفسارات الموظفين والإجابة عليها، ومتابعة معاملاتهم بالتنسيق مع موظفي الوحدات الخارجية المعنية. إحاطة الموظفين بكافة المستجدات المتعلقة بمعاملاتهم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال العلاقات الحكومية أو ما يعادلها. فهم جيد للإجراءات والقوانين الحكومية ذات الصلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الوثائق والمعلومات بسرية تامة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، ويوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ضمن فريق مطعم عائض للوجبات السريعة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بمتابعة المعاملات الحكومية وشؤون الموظفين بكفاءة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

Address special requests from guests with unique needs and follow up to ensure satisfaction. Gather, summarize, and provide information to guests about property amenities, local attractions, special events, and activities. a9141d37740d487c.description: Salla is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce platforms in the MENA region, delivering innovative technology solutions that empower businesses to scale rapidly. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a Category Manager – Mahally. As Category Manager, you own what gets featured, analyze what's selling, curate the best products, build the lists for every major campaign, and work with marketing and growth teams closely on campaigns. Your decisions directly impact GMV. You Will: Build the yearly promotional calendar: 11.11, White Friday, Ramadan, Eids, National Day, Founding Day, pay week and seasonal moments. Choose the focus categories for each campaign, based on what's selling and what the season calls for. Build the product lists for each campaign and set a GMV target for it. Own the category tree in Arabic and English, organised around how people shop, not how merchants list. Find winning products and merchants: right price vs market, real demand, reliable delivery. Bring in merchants who aren't selling on Mahally yet. Own merchandising: decide which products, stores and categories go into homepage banners, store tiles, category tiles and search, refresh them on schedule, and replace what doesn't perform. Work with CRM, marketing and growth on targeting and timing. Analyze category performance and watch competitor marketplaces to spot trends, opportunities and gaps, then adjust the strategy. Experience: Minimum 3+ years in category management or marketplace operations on large-scale eCommerce platforms, with a proven ability to drive category performance and GMV growth. SKU Management: Experience managing 50,000+ SKUs, including curating top-performing products, maintaining listing quality, and optimizing product visibility for campaigns. Data & Analytics: Proficiency in SQL for extracting and analyzing your own data, with experience using analytics/BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, or equivalent. Able to generate insights to inform category decisions. Traffic & Marketing: Demonstrated knowledge of key traffic-driving mechanisms, including Search, Email, SEO, and Affiliates, and ability to coordinate campaigns with marketing and growth teams to maximize engagement and GMV. Consumer & Market Insight: Strong understanding of consumer behavior and market dynamics, with the ability to analyze category performance, identify trends, opportunities, and gaps, and adapt strategies based on competitor activity. a92efa6fd4db1c82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بصمة جنين عن فني تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة المبرز. يركز هذا الدور على دعم قسم المبيعات من خلال تطوير وتنفيذ تصاميم داخلية مبتكرة، مع التركيز على أنظمة الألوان، واختيار الأثاث والمواد، وتحديد أماكن القطع داخل المساحات الداخلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني التصميم الداخلي مسؤولية مباشرة تنفيذ خطط التصميم، وضمان التزامها بالمعايير والجودة المطلوبة. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: وضع التصاميم للمشروعات الداخلية وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للتنفيذ. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. ضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات والقواعد واللوائح ذات الصلة ومباشرة تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك خلفية قوية في التصميم الداخلي، مع القدرة على تحويل الأفكار إلى تصاميم عملية وجذابة. الخبرة المطلوبة هي 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله مناسباً للخريجين الجدد أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التصميم الداخلي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المبيعات في شركة بصمة جنين. يقع مقر العمل في المبرز بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويوفر بيئة داعمة للنمو المهني في مجال التصميم الداخلي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

a96633bcd6652dcb.description: About the Role Al Manhal Water Factory (Nestlé Waters KSA) is seeking a Quality Manager to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a9a22d6c084b753d.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a dedicated Weighbridge Operator to join their team in Jeddah. Compile summary sheets for scrap shifting from ISPC. Cross-check supplier billet delivery notes against the Daily Dispatch report to identify non-receipt of trucks. Prepare Farah Trucks movement reports for imported billets and random reports for finished products to calculate actual weights. Maintain weighbridge calibration accuracy and notify superiors about scheduled maintenance and calibration needs. Execute all tasks in compliance with ISO requirements. Proficiency in using SAP systems for data entry and slip generation. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data management. a9aaef5478451f4a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صقور التنميه للتجارة والمقاولات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. يعمل مندوب المبيعات كجزء من فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

a9f6e7049157dfe5.description: About the Role Lucid is seeking a Maintenance Mechanical Technician to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves performing mechanical diagnostics, repairs, adjustments, and component replacements on vehicles within the General Assembly area. The technician will ensure that all mechanical systems operate according to OEM specifications, contributing to minimized downtime and consistent production flow. Key Responsibilities Diagnose mechanical issues related to chassis, suspension, steering, brakes, closures, and interior mechanisms. Repair or replace mechanical components such as hinges, latches, actuators, fasteners, brackets, and linkages. Verify torque values, fastener integrity, and joint quality using approved tools and procedures. Perform adjustments on doors, hoods, liftgates, and seats to meet fit, flush, and functional requirements. Respond promptly to mechanical breakdowns and use mechanical drawings, schematics, and manuals to diagnose faults. Coordinate with electrical, quality, and production teams for integrated problem resolution and support root cause analysis for recurring failures. Assist in the installation, alignment, and testing of new mechanical fixtures, tools, and equipment. Follow all mechanical safety procedures, LOTO requirements, and PPE guidelines, reporting any hazards or unsafe conditions. Ensure mechanical systems operate within defined parameters to support stable General Assembly quality and perform necessary quality checks. Complete repair work orders, inspection checklists, and fault reports accurately, maintaining records of mechanical repairs and modifications. Experience with automated assembly equipment, conveyors, and mechanical systems is preferred. Mechanical repair certification or trade license is preferred. Willingness to work shifts and support production requirements. a9f76aefe16f89da.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Furnace Operator to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves the precise execution of heat sequences and charging control for a designated furnace, ensuring proper billet handling, continuous process monitoring, and strict adherence to all safety protocols. The ideal candidate will have 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Key Responsibilities Execute heat sequences and charging control by reviewing daily plans, operating charging tables and roller tables to move billets, and using the cold billet pusher to charge billets at defined pitches. Visually inspect each billet for defects such as bending, cracks, or identification mismatches before charging, and report non-conforming billets. Record charging data accurately, including the time of first and last billet arrival, total billets charged per heat, and the number of short/separator or reusable billets. Document and communicate any deviations from the sequence. Monitor furnace temperatures from thermocouples in charging and soaking zones, reporting any abnormal readings or sensor failures immediately. Coordinate with the Senior Furnace Operator regarding charging rate adjustments. Maintain continuous communication with the Furnace Discharging Operator, Main Pulpit Operator, and Billet Handling Office to ensure operational alignment and address issues. Inform the Senior Furnace Operator or Shift-in-Charge promptly about any abnormal mechanical, electrical, or gas supply issues affecting charging operations. Perform basic operator-level checks on charging equipment, reporting any abnormalities to mechanical maintenance. Ensure the charging grid and surrounding areas are kept clean and free from obstructions to prevent hazards. Safety and Emergency Response Adhere strictly to lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) and isolation procedures before any intervention involving moving parts. Immediately stop charging and secure the area in cases of mill line stoppage, furnace over-temperature, gas alarms, interlock activation, uncontrolled billet movement, or suspected mechanical failure. Participate in emergency drills related to gas leaks, fires, and furnace trip scenarios as defined by EHS and Loss Prevention. Support furnace shutdown activities by assisting in the safe removal of residual billets and ensuring equipment is cleared and parked safely. Assist in data collection for root cause analysis related to charging-side stoppages, billet sequencing errors, or yield losses. Participate in toolbox talks and refresher trainings on furnace operation, material identification, LOTO, and safe lifting/handling. Provide on-the-job guidance to new operators or helpers under the supervision of the Furnace Foreman. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in an operational or industrial setting, preferably with exposure to furnace operations or heavy machinery. Ability to understand and follow detailed operational procedures and safety protocols. Strong attention to detail for visual verification and data recording. Effective communication skills for coordinating with various teams and reporting issues. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, requiring active participation in a dynamic industrial environment. The role involves working closely with other operators and maintenance teams to ensure continuous and safe furnace operations.

a95e52b87c13a06e.description: About the Role Mott MacDonald is seeking a Senior Design Manager to support the planning, coordination, management, and delivery of multidisciplinary design activities. Manage day-to-day coordination of detailed-design activities and packages, ensuring designs are integrated and fit for purpose. Support design scope and change management by clarifying contractual deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, and responsibilities, and identifying potential scope gaps or changes. Support compliance with applicable Saudi codes, authority requirements, client standards, and international engineering standards. Monitor design progress against deliverables, milestones, program, and resource requirements, escalating delays as needed. Maintain and monitor design deliverable schedules, action trackers, interface registers, and design-review records. Desirable: Understanding of the Saudi Arabian project-delivery and authority-approval environment. Desirable: Familiarity with relevant Saudi codes, standards, and authority requirements, alongside applicable international standards. Desirable: Chartered or professionally registered status, or demonstrable progress towards professional registration. Desirable: Experience using building information modeling, common data environments, and ISO 19650-based information-management processes. Desirable: Experience working within a multidisciplinary engineering or built-environment consultancy. Desirable: Experience supporting design-and-build or contractor-led detailed-design delivery. Desirable: General awareness of FIDIC or comparable forms of contract used on major Middle Eastern projects. Desirable: Experience engaging with clients, developers, government organizations, contractors, and delivery partners within Saudi Arabia. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, requiring effective operation within the Saudi Arabian project-delivery environment. The role involves collaboration with diverse stakeholders, including clients, contractors, consultants, and technical teams. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

a9fe4a694423ed66.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts is seeking a Laundry Attendant Supervisor to join our team in Jeddah. Identify stained or damaged items and determine appropriate action for repair, spot treatment, rewash, or discard. Inspect the cleanliness of laundered articles and place them into clean linen carts. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabric types. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain traps after each load. Fold cleaned articles to designated sizes, either manually or using a folding machine. Maintain accurate records of all laundered items. Operational Standards and Safety Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. a9150611b362e294.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاديب للخدمات اللوجستية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات وسياسات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين، الإجازات، وتحديث البيانات، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج حسب الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية، المرضية، الطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات، الإعارة، وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق كافة البيانات مثل الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لإجراءات وأنظمة وسياسات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع الموظفين والإدارات المختلفة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الاديب للخدمات اللوجستية.

a947bc787105781a.description: We are seeking a proactive and organised Customer Service Officer to support logistics and delivery operations within the Supply Chain team. Understanding of health and safety practices within logistics and warehouse operations. Proficiency in tracking, reporting, and monitoring operational performance.
